label: Hand-set energy (focused Gibbs T=0)
test_set: EqR maze-30x30-unique-1k test (1,000 mazes), x 3 inference seeds
notes: Hand-set energy, no learned parameters, no training: CRAMMazeEnergy (16 stored values) set to {"Fp": [[0.1, 1.0, 0.1]], "Gp": [[0.1, 1.0, 0.1]], "P": [[[0.0, 0.0], [1.0, 0.0]]], "Q": [[[0.0, 0.0], [-5.0, 0.0]]], "b": [0.0, -1.5]}: an on open cell costs 1.5 - (on side neighbours) - 0.1 (on diagonal neighbours); walls clamped off, S and G clamped on. focused Gibbs at T 0 from every open cell on (maze_unique.gibbs, focus random, max 20,000 moves): each move sets one free cell that is not at its lowest-energy answer, chosen uniformly among them, to that answer; a maze stops at a fixed point (no such cell left). Repeats: inference seeds 0, 1, 2 (cram-fg used focus seed 0 for each training seed).

extra.flop_convention: maze_unique.gibbs_flop, as cram-fg: one full current (2 x 2 x 2 x 9 x 900 = 64,800 flop) plus per move 4 x 8 (the field change at the 8 neighbours) + 2 x 900 (focus); a multiply-add is 2 flop
